  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The intellect of the intellectual soul is inherently a yesh, from kelipas nogah, so even after it recognizes its distance from G-dliness, its self-nullification is incomparable to that of the Elokis soul, which is nullified in its very existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, since the intellect of the intellectual soul, in and of itself, is a category of yesh,</t>
    <t s="2">and moreover, it is from kelipas nogah,</t>
    <t s="3">therefore,</t>
    <t s="4">even after the intellect of the intellectual soul grasps the remoteness of its value relative to G-dliness</t>
    <t s="5">[for its comprehension of matters of G-dliness is with limitation and corporealization, and it does not grasp matters as they truly are],</t>
    <t s="6">through which it comes to a state of bittul,</t>
    <t s="7">its bittul is in no way comparable to the bittul of the Elokis soul.</t>
    <t s="8">For in the Elokis soul,</t>
    <t s="9">its bittul is in its very existence,</t>
    <t s="10">whereas in the intellectual soul,</t>
    <t s="11">its bittul is something additional to its existence,</t>
    <t s="12">and in its essence it is a category of yesh.</t>
    <t s="13">And this is that a courtyard roofed with a ceiling is a courtyard, which is a place where animals are found</t>
    <t s="14">(as above, section 2)</t>
    <t s="15">and not a human dwelling,</t>
    <t s="16">for Adam, whose gematria is 45,</t>
    <t s="17">is the bittul of the Elokis soul, which is called Adam, from the term "adameh l'Elyon" [I will be like the Most High],</t>
    <t s="18">in contrast to the bittul of the animal soul and the intellectual soul, which is bittul hayesh,</t>
    <t s="19">it is a category of chayah, which is below Adam.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even within the bittul of the Elokis soul, there are two general levels: the intellect and emotions as they are in themselves, and as they become clothed in the animal and intellectual souls, where the revealed aspect has bittul hayesh and the inner aspect is G-dliness with bittul bimetzius.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Now, also regarding the bittul of the Elokis soul,</t>
    <t s="1">there are two general levels.</t>
    <t s="2">For it is known</t>
    <t s="3">that in order for the Elokis soul to act upon the animal soul and the intellectual soul, it is through the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul coming into measure and limitation, in a way that they will be relevant to the intellectual soul and also to the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="4">to the extent that they become clothed in the intellect and emotions of the intellectual soul and the animal soul.</t>
    <t s="5">Thus,</t>
    <t s="6">in the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul,</t>
    <t s="7">there are two levels:</t>
    <t s="8">as they are in themselves, and as they become clothed in the intellectual and animal souls.</t>
    <t s="9">And based on what is explained elsewhere,</t>
    <t s="10">that the power within the Elokis soul to effect the refinement and purification of the animal soul is according to the fact that the Elokis soul is G-dliness in its very essence,</t>
    <t s="11">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="12">that also in the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul as they become clothed in the animal soul, there are two aspects.</t>
    <t s="13">In their revelation</t>
    <t s="14">(as they are relative to the intellectual and animal souls)</t>
    <t s="15">they are in measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="16">and their bittul is similar to bittul hayesh</t>
    <t s="17">(therefore they act upon the intellectual and animal souls),</t>
    <t s="18">and in their inwardness they are G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="19">and their bittul is bittul bimetzius.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The four aspects—the two levels of the courtyard (refinement of animal and intellectual souls) and the two aspects of the Elokis soul's powers (revealed and essential)—correspond to the four worlds Atzilus, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, where Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence with bittul hayesh, Beriah is potential existence with bittul bimetzius from intellect, and Atzilus is utter non-existence with true bittul bimetzius from G-dliness itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that the four matters mentioned above—the two levels of the courtyard, which are the refinement of the animal soul and the intellectual soul,</t>
    <t s="3">and the two aspects in the powers of the Elokis soul as they are in revelation and as they are in their very essence—are analogous to the four worlds ABY"A.</t>
    <t s="4">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="5">that Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence,</t>
    <t s="6">Beriah is only potential existence,</t>
    <t s="7">and Atzilus is the cessation of existence.</t>
    <t s="8">And among the distinctions between Asiyah and Yetzirah</t>
    <t s="9">(existence)</t>
    <t s="10">and Beriah</t>
    <t s="11">(potential existence)</t>
    <t s="12">is,</t>
    <t s="13">that the bittul in Asiyah and Yetzirah is bittul hayesh,</t>
    <t s="14">for since Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence,</t>
    <t s="15">their bittul is something additional to their existence.</t>
    <t s="16">And the bittul in Beriah,</t>
    <t s="17">which is only potential existence,</t>
    <t s="18">is bittul bimetzius,</t>
    <t s="19">meaning that its entire existence is bittul.</t>
    <t s="20">And this is</t>
    <t s="21">that Yetzirah is the abode of angels whose service is with natural awe and love,</t>
    <t s="22">and Beriah is the abode of the souls of the righteous whose service was with intellectual awe and love</t>
    <t s="23">(and also the angels whose service is with intellectual awe and love, their place is in Beriah),</t>
    <t s="24">for natural awe and love are the nature</t>
    <t s="25">(the existence)</t>
    <t s="26">of the created being,</t>
    <t s="27">and intellectual awe and love are that the love and fear are not from his nature and existence, but because the G-dly matter he grasped obligates that he must love G-d and fear Him.</t>
    <t s="28">However,</t>
    <t s="29">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="30">since in Beriah there is the matter of comprehension,</t>
    <t s="31">and the bittul in Beriah is because the intellect obligates that relative to G-dliness there is no place for existence,</t>
    <t s="32">so even this bittul is existence,</t>
    <t s="33">and the true matter of bittul bimetzius is in Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="34">for the bittul in Atzilus is not from the grasp of intellect, but from G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="35">that He alone is, and there is nothing besides Him.</t>
    <t s="36">Therefore, in the world of Atzilus, the existence of angels does not apply</t>
    <t s="37">(not even intellectual angels),</t>
    <t s="38">and the world of Atzilus is the abode for the great tzaddikim who were in the category of a Merkavah, above intellect,</t>
    <t s="39">bittul bimetzius.</t>
    <t s="40">And although even in Atzilus there are ten Sefiros</t>
    <t s="41">(intellect and emotions),</t>
    <t s="42">nevertheless, the Sefiros of Atzilus are not existence</t>
    <t s="43">(unto themselves)</t>
    <t s="44">at all,</t>
    <t s="45">for He and His life are one, He and His limbs are one.</t>
  </section>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The intellect of the intellectual soul is inherently a yesh, from kelipas nogah, so even after it recognizes its distance from G-dliness, its self-nullification is incomparable to that of the Elokis soul, which is nullified in its very existence.

translations.translation: Now, since the intellect of the intellectual soul, in and of itself, is a category of yesh,
and moreover, it is from kelipas nogah,
therefore,
even after the intellect of the intellectual soul grasps the remoteness of its value relative to G-dliness
[for its comprehension of matters of G-dliness is with limitation and corporealization, and it does not grasp matters as they truly are],
through which it comes to a state of bittul,
its bittul is in no way comparable to the bittul of the Elokis soul.
For in the Elokis soul,
its bittul is in its very existence,
whereas in the intellectual soul,
its bittul is something additional to its existence,
and in its essence it is a category of yesh.
And this is that a courtyard roofed with a ceiling is a courtyard, which is a place where animals are found
(as above, section 2)
and not a human dwelling,
for Adam, whose gematria is 45,
is the bittul of the Elokis soul, which is called Adam, from the term "adameh l'Elyon" [I will be like the Most High],
in contrast to the bittul of the animal soul and the intellectual soul, which is bittul hayesh,
it is a category of chayah, which is below Adam.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Even within the bittul of the Elokis soul, there are two general levels: the intellect and emotions as they are in themselves, and as they become clothed in the animal and intellectual souls, where the revealed aspect has bittul hayesh and the inner aspect is G-dliness with bittul bimetzius.

translations.translation: Now, also regarding the bittul of the Elokis soul,
there are two general levels.
For it is known

that in order for the Elokis soul to act upon the animal soul and the intellectual soul, it is through the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul coming into measure and limitation, in a way that they will be relevant to the intellectual soul and also to the animal soul,
to the extent that they become clothed in the intellect and emotions of the intellectual soul and the animal soul.
Thus,
in the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul,
there are two levels:
as they are in themselves, and as they become clothed in the intellectual and animal souls.
And based on what is explained elsewhere,
that the power within the Elokis soul to effect the refinement and purification of the animal soul is according to the fact that the Elokis soul is G-dliness in its very essence,
it can be said,
that also in the intellect and emotions of the Elokis soul as they become clothed in the animal soul, there are two aspects.
In their revelation
(as they are relative to the intellectual and animal souls)
they are in measure and limitation,
and their bittul is similar to bittul hayesh
(therefore they act upon the intellectual and animal souls),
and in their inwardness they are G-dliness,
and their bittul is bittul bimetzius.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The four aspects—the two levels of the courtyard (refinement of animal and intellectual souls) and the two aspects of the Elokis soul's powers (revealed and essential)—correspond to the four worlds Atzilus, Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, where Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence with bittul hayesh, Beriah is potential existence with bittul bimetzius from intellect, and Atzilus is utter non-existence with true bittul bimetzius from G-dliness itself.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that the four matters mentioned above—the two levels of the courtyard, which are the refinement of the animal soul and the intellectual soul,
and the two aspects in the powers of the Elokis soul as they are in revelation and as they are in their very essence—are analogous to the four worlds ABY"A.
And the explanation is,
that Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence,
Beriah is only potential existence,
and Atzilus is the cessation of existence.
And among the distinctions between Asiyah and Yetzirah
(existence)
and Beriah
(potential existence)
is,
that the bittul in Asiyah and Yetzirah is bittul hayesh,
for since Asiyah and Yetzirah are existence,
their bittul is something additional to their existence.
And the bittul in Beriah,
which is only potential existence,
is bittul bimetzius,
meaning that its entire existence is bittul.
And this is
that Yetzirah is the abode of angels whose service is with natural awe and love,
and Beriah is the abode of the souls of the righteous whose service was with intellectual awe and love
(and also the angels whose service is with intellectual awe and love, their place is in Beriah),
for natural awe and love are the nature
(the existence)
of the created being,
and intellectual awe and love are that the love and fear are not from his nature and existence, but because the G-dly matter he grasped obligates that he must love G-d and fear Him.
However,
nevertheless,
since in Beriah there is the matter of comprehension,
and the bittul in Beriah is because the intellect obligates that relative to G-dliness there is no place for existence,
so even this bittul is existence,
and the true matter of bittul bimetzius is in Atzilus,
for the bittul in Atzilus is not from the grasp of intellect, but from G-dliness,
that He alone is, and there is nothing besides Him.
Therefore, in the world of Atzilus, the existence of angels does not apply
(not even intellectual angels),
and the world of Atzilus is the abode for the great tzaddikim who were in the category of a Merkavah, above intellect,
bittul bimetzius.
And although even in Atzilus there are ten Sefiros
(intellect and emotions),
nevertheless, the Sefiros of Atzilus are not existence
(unto themselves)
at all,
for He and His life are one, He and His limbs are one.
